verdict.rationale: Motion documents and exposes a live REST API (with real auth enforcement) for creating/updating projects and tasks, confirmed by both docs and a runtime probe, but the evidence only covers basic CRUD—there's no indication that the many UI-exclusive AI features (AI Calendar scheduling, Meeting Assistant, AI Search, Workflow Builder, Notetaker, Gantt/timeline views) are accessible via API. Missing for 10: API coverage for AI scheduling/calendar automation, meeting assistant features, workflow builder, notetaker, and reporting/dashboard functionality that exist in the UI.
